visualCharacteristics: Grid of Content Fragment items. curators: 3-up portrait cards with region eyebrow, name, bio and Meet link. destinations: 2x2 landscape image cards with country, name and tagline. services: 4-up bordered numbered cards with arrow link. testimonials: 3-up bordered quotes, featured quote on a beige fill. experiences: 3-up cards with title, line icon and text. stays: 2-up large image cards with name and text. features: 2 text columns in a rounded beige band with a divider.
reuseGuidance: Use whenever the list items are Content Fragments. Set the Fragment Type option to match the referenced model. Section intro (eyebrow, heading, paragraph) stays default content before the block.
usageDescription: Lists of structured entities authored as AEM Content Fragments (Curator, Destination, Service, Testimonial models). Each item references one fragment; the block loads it through a GraphQL persisted query.
